newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia bonds reverse spread narrowing bias.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia bonds reverse spread narrowing bias.

text.p: Australian bonds reversed an initial mild outperforming bias against other dollar bloc bonds with the market looking somewhat heavy going into the close.
The local market continues to meet resistance in taking the 10-year bond yield towards 7.0 percent, while U.S. Treasuries continue to find a firm foothold.
A technical buoyant U.S. market was further fuelled by a solid response to Wednesday's 5-year note auction.
Canadian bonds were pretty much in tune with the U.S. market, while New Zealand bond yields rose slightly in a fairly thin trading session.
